title: Argentinian Skillet Beef
description: A hearty and flavorful beef dish inspired by the cuisine of Argentina, cooked in a skillet to perfection.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
3. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet. Add the onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until translucent.
4. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
5. Add the bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
6. Add the tomato and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
7. Add the browned beef back into the skillet and stir in the chimichurri sauce.
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
9. Serve the beef and sauce over rice or with crusty bread.
10. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
